live_proof: inspection in the 3.22.0 tree: the JEACH_JSON arm of jsonEachColumn returns p->sParse.zJson as SQLITE_STATIC while jsonEachFilter allocates p->zJson and jsonEachCursorReset frees it. Fixed upstream in 3.45.2 by switching to SQLITE_TRANSIENT
object: p->zJson, the cursor's own malloc'd copy of the input JSON, handed to the SQL layer as SQLITE_STATIC
lifetime_ender: driving json_each from the right of a join re-filters it per outer row, and each jsonEachFilter calls jsonEachCursorReset, freeing the previous zJson
fidelity: real consumer, real allocator. The accumulator is the part that makes it observable: SQLITE_STATIC means no copy is made and sqlite3VdbeMemCopy keeps MEM_Static as-is, so a min()/max() accumulator retains the raw pointer and minmaxStep() compares against freed memory. Built in the json group
